$comment: Island amenities built from their spaces (Wiki: Island amenity, Rowboat (amenity)). Each site is one varbit by gameval: 0 shows the space (Build, Inspect) on the island, 1 shows the built amenity there and, for a rowboat, its mainland twin (the _in multiloc, hidden at 0). Each site's base multiloc (loc) is the one at its space. Rowboats: 50 Construction, a hammer and a saw, 8 camphor planks and 10 swamp paste, 1297 XP (Wiki). Their Travel is a ferries route (plugins/world/data/ferries.json, rowboat-*). Not captured: human_poh_build on the build, as the house's hotspots play it, and the messages are ours.
